name: JoinLoading
_doc: The loading screen on joining a server (src/client/Menus, Config/JoinLoading; user 2026-11-04: every player goes through it, the RUNENKRIEG words of the main menu kept over the armory's cinematic, src/client/EndScenes, while the whole current map loads; no skip). The title screen's name, trench line and font where they stand on the title screen, over a shade on the left; under them how far the map is loaded. Once it is, the title screen's buttons appear under the same words. Colours: Config/Palette UI.Grimoire.
